sn45.7:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || la || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn45.7:2.1: Rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayo ti bhante vuccati || kissa nu kho etam bhante adhivacanaṃ rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayo ti || || Nibbānadhātuyā kho etam bhikkhu adhivacanam rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayoti || āsavānaṃ khayo tena vuccatī ti || ||
sn45.7:3.1: Evam vutte so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Amatam amatan ti bhante vuccati || || Katanaṃ nu kho bhante amataṃ || katamo amatagāmimaggo ti || || Yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo || idaṃ vuccati amataṃ || || Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo amatagāmimaggo || seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || pe || sammāsamādhī ti || || Sāvatthi
